name: Deleting a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Deleted' email to every admin
description:
Objective: Deleting a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Deleted' email to every admin.
Preconditions: Open Permission set emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Permission set emails.
2. Deleting a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Deleted' email to every admin.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Deleting a permission set must send PERMISSION_SET_DELETED to every active admin other than the one who deleted it, naming the deleted set.
